name: forge
description: Provider-agnostic engineering workflow for the VS Code Agents window: full research and investigation for every new ticket, revision-aware review gates with 1, 5, 10, and 15 minute reading levels, named ticket worktrees and session titles, a ticket board, a Forge Master overview agent, automation templates, a repository wiki, and daily recaps. Existing tickets retain their original process. Say 'set up forge' to configure your tracker, repository host, and CI in the repository wiki.
